risks.risk: Alternator may not function or has not been tested
risks.proof: Video of bench test showing output voltage and rotor spin, or multimeter reading at terminals

risks.risk: Age or mileage of the unit is unknown
risks.proof: Clear photo of any label, stamp, or part number, plus service history or receipt

risks.risk: Compatible vehicle make and model is unknown
risks.proof: Photo of part number and fitment list, or pulley/mounting compared to a specific engine

risks.risk: Internal bearings and brushes may be worn
risks.proof: Video of shaft spinning freely without noise, or disassembly photo showing brushes and bearings
Screenshot or written statement of warranty/return policy
risks.if_unproven: Priced as as-is with no returns

proof_requests: Bench test video showing alternator output
Photo of any label or part number
Video of pulley spinning and shaft play
Statement of warranty or return terms
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a used car alternator, so it can be valued at its worst case as an untested unit; seller claims about dealing in parts cannot be verified from the photos.
